title: P2: same state and inputs, same future

statements.text: P2: identical complete present local states evolving under identical physical inputs have identical subsequent local physical states, $X^\alpha_t = X^\beta_t \wedge I^\alpha_{>t} = I^\beta_{>t} \Rightarrow X^\alpha_{>t} = X^\beta_{>t}$. This is the state sufficiency of physics, and it underwrites experimental replicability.

sources.quote: Local state sufficiency, described in P2, states that identical complete present local states (i), evolving under identical physical inputs (ii), have identical subsequent local physical states (iii)
the assumption underwriting experimental replicability, since preparing the same system under the same conditions is expected to yield the same result
